update.result.up_to_date: No newer release found, {from_version} is up to date.
update.result.not_available: No update package is available right now. Please try again later.

update.result.failed_unknown: Update stopped before anything was changed. {from_version} runs as before.
update.result.rolled_back: Update to {to_version} didn't work. ReceiptPi runs {from_version} again, with data and settings as they were before the update.

update.result.rollback_failed: Update to {to_version} didn't work, and neither did going back to {from_version}. Please see the help on updates.
update.install.heading: Install an update
update.install.hint: ReceiptPi looks for the latest release, checks its signature and checksum and installs it next to the running version. It backs up data and settings first. This usually takes a few minutes, longer when new Python packages are needed. While it switches over, ReceiptPi can't print for a short while. If something goes wrong, it goes back to the previous version by itself.
update.install.confirm: Yes, look for an update now and install it
update.install.button: Look for an update and install it
update.auto.heading: Automatic updates
update.auto.label: Automatic updates
update.auto.desc: Every night between 02:00 and 03:30, full releases only
update.auto.hint: The result receipt keeps to the quiet hours and otherwise waits under “Pending Jobs”.
